name: echo
description: Return the given text verbatim.

name: run_code
description: Execute arbitrary code in a sandbox. Always requires human approval.

name: web_search
description: Search the web and return top results. kind='web' for general web search, kind='news' for latest headlines, kind='wikipedia' for encyclopedia entries. Does not require approval.

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch a URL and return its text content as trimmed plain text. Use when a search snippet is not enough and you need the actual page content. Does not require approval.

name: send_email
description: Send an email via SMTP (config: AGENT_CORE_SMTP_HOST / _PORT / _USER / _PASSWORD / _FROM; attachments resolve under AGENT_CORE_FILE_ROOT). Always requires human approval.

name: send_message
description: Send a chat message to a messaging channel over the MCP remote (opt-in via MCP_BASE_URL). Always requires human approval.

name: create_docx
description: Create a .docx document from a title and a list of sections.

name: create_pptx
description: Create a .pptx presentation from a title and a list of slides.

name: inspect_self
description: Return a live snapshot of the agent: name, session id, target, model, turn budget, estimated context usage, pending approval, current plan, and available tools. Does not require approval.

name: remember
description: Save a fact, preference, or lesson to long-term memory so it persists across sessions. kind is one of: fact, preference, lesson, session_summary.

name: recall
description: Search long-term memory for entries matching a topic. Empty topic recalls the most recent memories.

name: make_plan
description: Set an explicit multi-step plan for the current task (goal + ordered step descriptions). Each step that calls a tool still requires normal approval. Does not require approval itself.

name: update_plan
description: Mark a plan step as in_progress, done, failed, or skipped (optionally with a short result).

name: read_file
description: Read a UTF-8 text file under the allowed file root (AGENT_CORE_FILE_ROOT). Returns content, truncated to max_chars. Refuses known sensitive files (.env, *.{pem,key,pfx,p12,kdbx}, id_* keys, .ssh/*, .aws/*, credentials, ...) so secrets never enter the conversation; AGENT_CORE_FILE_ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1 overrides. Read-only.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a text file under the allowed file root. Atomic write; always requires human approval. An approved write may create or replace any file under the root, including sensitive-named files (later reads of those are refused unless AGENT_CORE_FILE_ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1).

name: edit_file
description: Replace one unique occurrence of old_string with new_string in a file under the allowed file root. Fails if old_string is absent or occurs more than once. Refuses known sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials, ...) unless AGENT_CORE_FILE_ALLOW_SENSITIVE=1. Atomic write; always requires human approval (an approved write may create or replace any file under the root).

name: list_dir
description: List entries of a directory under the allowed file root (directories end with '/'). Read-only.

name: glob
description: Find paths under the allowed file root matching a glob pattern (e.g. 'core/*.py', '**/*.md'). Read-only.

name: grep
description: Search file contents for a regular expression under the allowed file root. Returns 'path:line: text'. Sensitive files (.env, keys, credentials, ...) are skipped while scanning and the skip count is reported; an explicit grep on one is refused. Read-only.

name: agent
description: Spawn a bounded, one-level sub-agent to complete a goal and return its summary. Approval-gated tools inside the sub-agent bubble up to this session's approval gate.

name: run_skill
description: Activate a named skill: inject its prompt and constrain the available tools to the skill's allowlist for this turn. An allowlist, not an approval bypass.

name: list_skills
description: List installed skills (name, description, tool allowlist). Read-only.

name: task_create
description: Add a task to the session backlog (distinct from the plan). Does not require approval.

name: task_update
description: Update a task's status (optionally with a short result). Does not require approval.

name: task_list
description: List the session task backlog. Read-only.
